characters.description: The Atwood Empire's ruler and a dual-bodied cultivator preparing to enter the Imperial Graveyard. Rava is subjecting him to intensive heart training because his rapid growth has left his Dao heart vulnerable, and Zac is racing to finish his preparations before the expedition.
characters.name: Zac

characters.description: Zac's wife and a returning companion whom he expects to receive once his training obligations allow it.
characters.name: Catheya

characters.description: Zac's disciple and an Atwood combat leader. Rava's regimen exposes weaknesses in her path, prompting her to delay her middle-hegemony breakthrough for another round of refinement rather than advance on an unstable foundation.
characters.name: Emily

characters.description: Zac's instructor at the Empyrean Chalice. He directs a punishing corrective program centered on heart cultivation, urging Zac to adapt an existing method so that future advances rest on a more resilient inner foundation.
characters.name: Rava

characters.description: Zac's demon companion and a fellow seal bearer. He is separately exchanging merit for valuable training opportunities while Zac completes the remaining mystic-realm missions needed to fund their preparations.
characters.name: Ogras

characters.description: A powerful flame cultivator and independent ally who receives Zac and Catheya within her guarded portable residence. She recognizes signs of authority in Zac and shows interest in his changed state.
characters.name: Iz

characters.description: A flame cultivator who remains part of Zac's cycle despite his nominal status as the disciple of one of Iz's elders.
characters.name: Kruta

characters.description: An Undead Empire rival seal bearer who is expected to share the Imperial Graveyard operation with Zac. His political backing and unclear objectives make him a dangerous partner even before the expedition begins.
characters.name: Kator

characters.description: An Azal cultivator defending the interests of the Abyssal Shores. Kator removes her from his expedition group and seals communications, leading her to seek the Undead Empire's ruler and accept an unknown path after learning that the imperial heart is sealed.
characters.name: Tavza

characters.description: An Atwood spear cultivator and seal bearer selected for Zac's small infiltration force. She withstands Kator's killing intent and enters the operation as one of the trained fighters expected to protect its specialist members.
characters.name: Joanna

characters.description: An array specialist and seal bearer accompanying the Imperial Graveyard mission. His experience with the Centurion Lighthouse may help the group locate or operate ancient foreign-god technology beyond the Wall of Resolution.
characters.name: Galau

characters.description: An ancient thief secretly supporting Zac aboard the Aphelion. She can obscure his two bodies and hidden shrine from Kator's high-grade observer, although her misdirection works only across a limited area.
characters.name: Esmeralda

characters.description: An Adalon Autarch working with the White Sky Phalanx as an individual rather than through the Adalon hive mind. Her brand restrains Zac and the Epiclesis Bell, which she seals inside a spatial crystal.
characters.name: General Amol

characters.description: A realm spirit Zac previously met in the Perennial Vastness. His system-limited projection restores Zac to the state before an Autarch's sealing brand and breaks a developing karmic bond, though the projection cannot directly oppose the surrounding Autarchs.
characters.name: Sendor

characters.description: A secluded Autarch devoted to a pure path of oblivion. Together with Azu, he questions Zac after the dual atavism and tests whether Zac will discard his established path in favor of their more absolute approach.
characters.name: Bay Z

characters.description: A secluded Autarch devoted to pure creation and married to Bay Z. She helps explain how flawed primordial authority obstructs the broken peak of chaos, then examines the place Zac intends creation to hold within his broader Dao.
characters.name: Azu

characters.description: A captive held within the Epiclesis Bell and linked to the hostile entity inside it. Zac crosses the collapsing battlefield and enters the Bell in an effort to reach her.
characters.name: Velary

characters.description: An Aphelion technical specialist who works with Galau to inspect an anomalous section exposed by the ship's transformation. Their analysis identifies an inactive tracker integrated into the vessel's original propulsion design.
characters.name: Jowl

characters.description: A cultivator who reaches the ruins of Carnal Resolution and holds Zac responsible. Moro, the heart curse inhabiting him, urges acceptance of an unfinished Black Heart technique until Sorathom forces the parasite back under control.
characters.name: Sorathom

characters.description: A Lu-family young master, Flame Bearer, and controller of the Grand Centigrade Foundry. When he learns Iz is approaching, he assumes she is pursuing his seal and activates his foundries while redirecting his search.
characters.name: Kaltosa Lu

characters.description: One of Zac's covert allies and a seal bearer whose concealment is unusually effective against the eye-shaped trove's illusory battlefield. His muted presence helps the assault team understand what draws the realm's hostile attention.
characters.name: Carl

characters.description: A Farsea Court member traveling with Zac's expedition. The Centurion base refuses him entry despite admitting the seal bearers, leaving him aboard the damaged Aphelion with Jowl while the strike teams move inside.
characters.name: Ibtep

characters.description: The ancient custodian of the Ultum Courts, named by the Eternal and able to command the Lost Plain. He identifies Zac as a Flame Bearer candidate, challenges his reluctance to follow that path, and makes clear that candidacy brings no special protection.
characters.name: Walzo

characters.description: The Kan'Tanu leader pursuing a concealed ascension plan. He sabotages a Blackheart ritual gathering, transfers its karmic consequences to the crippled hallmaster, and sends an imperial-palace aura toward a hidden storm to provoke a response.
characters.name: Kan'Tanu Pope

characters.description: The niece of the Aphelion's sole trusted pilot. Her uncle must guide the ship alone after the other pilots are killed or mentally incapacitated.
characters.name: Thea

characters.description: A flame guard bound to an inherited destiny. Near the opening of the fifth-pillar contest, she briefly resists her assigned course and nudges a destiny mote before the inherited fate firmly regains control.
characters.name: Leara

characters.description: A Sangha figure who observes and influences fate. When the cosmic weave becomes too complex to manage directly, he stops intervening and watches the approaching fifth-pillar contest.
characters.name: Blessed Fate

characters.description: A prisoner punished for abusing causality while hunting near the River of Time's headwaters. He arrives at the River of Destiny to observe the approaching fifth-pillar contest.
characters.name: Old Man River

characters.description: An ancient power who joins the gathering at the River of Destiny as the fifth-pillar contest approaches. She warns the others not to interfere.
characters.name: Kulsara Tain
